title: Configuration window unclear on invalid background image settings
line: Fifteen Puzzle settings now warn when the background image is missing or can't be loaded, instead of silently using the color.
explanation: With Background set to Image, the Appearance page accepted an empty path or a file that isn't a loadable image without any hint. The board then silently fell back to the plain color, and reopening the settings still showed Image selected as if it worked. The page now loads the chosen path in a hidden Image and, while Image is selected and it fails (or no path is set), shows a warning header saying the background color will be used instead.

commits.message:
applets/fifteenPuzzle: warn when the background image can't be loaded

The settings accepted an empty path or a file that isn't a loadable image
without any hint, while the widget silently fell back to the color. Now the
Appearance page shows a warning when the chosen image can't be used.

BUG: 504914

patches.diff:
From 914eb86fe10454668dcdfb2e4c4613108628c09b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:43:46 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/fifteenPuzzle: warn when the background image can't
 be loaded

The settings accepted an empty path or a file that isn't a loadable image
without any hint, while the widget silently fell back to the color. Now the
Appearance page shows a warning when the chosen image can't be used.

BUG: 504914
---
 applets/fifteenPuzzle/qml/configAppearance.qml | 17 +++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 17 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/fifteenPuzzle/qml/configAppearance.qml b/applets/fifteenPuzzle/qml/configAppearance.qml
index aac74e801..42d26498d 100644
--- a/applets/fifteenPuzzle/qml/configAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/fifteenPuzzle/qml/configAppearance.qml
@@ -33,6 +33,15 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
         cfg_showNumerals = !hideNumeralsRadioButton.checked
     }
 
+    header: Kirigami.InlineMessage {
+        position: Kirigami.InlineMessage.Position.Header
+        type: Kirigami.MessageType.Warning
+        visible: imageBackgroundRadioButton.checked && imageProbe.status !== Image.Ready && imageProbe.status !== Image.Loading
+        text: imagePathTextField.text.length === 0
+            ? i18nc("@info", "No image is selected, so the background color will be used instead.")
+            : i18nc("@info", "The selected image cannot be loaded, so the background color will be used instead.")
+    }
+
     Kirigami.FormLayout {
 
         QtControls.ButtonGroup {
@@ -100,6 +109,14 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
                 ]
             }
 
+            Image {
+                id: imageProbe
+                visible: false
+                asynchronous: true
+                cache: false
+                source: imagePathTextField.text.length !== 0 ? "file://" + imagePathTextField.text : ""
+            }
+
             QtControls.Button {
                 id: imageButton
                 enabled: imageBackgroundRadioButton.checked
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Image set to /etc/hostname (not an image): accepted with no warning, the board keeps the plain color.
Same setting: the page now warns that the image can't be loaded and the color is used.
Image selected with an empty path: warning that no image is selected.
